question: Which of the following sequences **correctly **arranges the Vijayanagara rulers in the order of their reign periods?

options.text: Krishnadeva Raya → Harihara I → Devaraya II
Harihara I → Devaraya II → Krishnadeva Raya
Devaraya II → Krishnadeva Raya → Harihara I
Devaraya II → Harihara I → Krishnadeva Raya

solution:
The correct answer is __**Harihara I → Devaraya II → Krishnadeva Raya**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• **Harihara I (1336–1356):** 
 
 
• Harihara I was the **founder** of the Vijayanagara Empire along with his brother Bukka Raya I in **1336**.
 
• His reign marked the beginning of the **Sangama dynasty** in South India.
 
• He established the empire to resist invasions from the Delhi Sultanate and to revive Hindu culture.
 
 
 
• **Devaraya II (1424–1446):**
 
 
• Devaraya II was one of the most prominent rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire from the **Sangama dynasty**.
 
• He was known for his military campaigns and for expanding the empire’s territory significantly.
 
• Devaraya II was a patron of art and culture, and his court was adorned with scholars and poets.
